summaryDeep:
This person may misunderstand you in a way that gets under your skin. The tension isn't necessarily about what is being said. It's about the gap between what is meant and what is received. This person may reflect something back to you that feels slightly off. They may think they understand your intentions while missing an important piece of your experience. You may find yourself repeating, clarifying, or trying to find new language for something that feels obvious from your side.

That can be exhausting. It can also be revealing.

Squares ask us to work. They shine a light on patterns that may be holding you back from deeper connection. In this relationship, misunderstandings can become opportunities for growth. You may be encouraged to communicate more clearly and express what you truly mean, rather than assuming the other person already knows. They may be encouraged to slow down, stay curious, and listen with an open mind before jumping to conclusions.

When the tension builds, conversations can turn into arguments about who understands the situation better. One person feels unseen. The other feels like their efforts are being dismissed. Instead of getting curious, both people may become defensive.

The growth here comes from slowing down. Not by accepting being misunderstood, but by staying in the conversation long enough to understand each other more clearly. This connection isn't really about proving who's right. It's about both of you getting better at seeing each other for who you actually are, instead of getting stuck in your own assumptions about each other.
